name: @heyloo/widget
description: The embeddable website widget (BUILD_PLAN Cluster W): a tiny, framework-free floating button + panel (Voice web-call mode, Chat mode) rendered inside a shadow root so a tenant's page CSS can never leak in or out. Built with tsup (esbuild under the hood) to a single ES5-safe IIFE, no third-party CDN, no runtime dependency on React/the rest of the monorepo — this package is loaded directly in an arbitrary third-party page via a <script> tag (`apps/web/src/app/widget.js/route.ts` serves the built output), so it must stand completely alone.
